items.title: Will Pakistan-Saudi-Turkiye alliance actually create a new regional order?
items.description: The Mecca Joint Defence Pact brings together countries that sit between Iran and Israel, but will it be effective?

items.title: Testosterone and fertility: the trade-off men aren't told about
items.description: Testosterone is trending in gyms, on social online and in politics. US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth even wants troops screened for low testosterone. But taking supplements can shut down the body's natural production.

items.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
items.description: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.

items.title: Thailand: Several killed in school shooting north of Bangkok
items.description: The shooting incident took place at the Debsirin Nonthaburi School in ​the ‌Bang Kruai district of Nonthaburi, just north of the capital city of Bangkok. Several people were killed in the attack.

items.title: U.S. Senate passes Russia sanctions bill that seeks 100% tariffs on India, four others
items.description: The bill, renamed the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, was approved by the Senate by an 86-11 vote

items.title: Germany: Far-right AfD extends its lead in nationwide polls
items.description: In the latest Sunday poll, the AfD continues to pull ahead. And more and more people are against excluding the right-wing populists from decision-making, at least on a case-by-case basis.

items.title: German airport drone-bomb: Could Russia be involved?
items.description: The BBC has seen evidence from previous cases that Russian-linked proxies not only handled drones and explosives, but also delivered them to Germany.
